name: Weltrend Semiconductor, Inc.
summary: Weltrend Semiconductor, Inc., a fabless semiconductor company, plans, designs, tests, develops, and distributes integrated circuit (IC) products in Taiwan, Mainland China, and internationally. The company researches, develops, produces, tests and sells digital and analog hybrid application-specific integrated circuits, digital and analog integrated circuits. It also imports and exports electronic parts. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
